name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt the 3-pixel solid focus ring in the brand color with a 3-pixel outer glow. This decision provides sufficient visual contrast for users with impairments, making it easier for them to navigate the site via keyboard. By choosing this option, we're accepting a slightly thicker focus ring that may not be as aesthetically minimal as a 2-pixel ring, but the increased accessibility benefits outweigh the minor visual trade-off. This choice also aligns with established accessibility guidelines, ensuring EXCAVA is usable by everyone, including those with visual or motor impairments.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring + 3px glow risks obscuring adjacent content at 125% zoom—especially for users with low vision who rely on magnification. A 2px ring with 2px glow at 20% opacity meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast while reducing bleed, but only if tested at 200% zoom. Settle this by running a live keyboard navigation test with screen readers and high-contrast mode.
